cohort: Singleton primiparas who underwent TPUS examination at 6-8 weeks postpartum
finding: A nomogram integrating clinical and sonographic characteristics, including BMI, delivery mode, lateral episiotomy, SUI during pregnancy, cystocele, and bladder neck funneling, showed good efficiency in assessing postpartum SUI risk.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was one of the predictors included in the nomogram for assessing postpartum SUI risk.
